raise-error.description: #[output application/java --- 'An archived report already exists at ' ++ vars.ctx.archivePath ++ ' and can never be overwritten']

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import toBase64 from dw::core::Binaries import sha256Hex from dwl::report output application/java --- [ { method: "POST", path: "/archive", body: { runId: vars.runId, fileType: "SUBMISSION", fileName: vars.ctx.fileName, checksum: vars.ctx.fileChecksum, contentBase64: toBase64(vars.fileBytes) } }, { method: "POST", path: "/archive", body: { runId: vars.runId, fileType: "SUMMARY", fileName: vars.ctx.summaryFileName, checksum: sha256Hex(vars.summaryBytes), contentBase64: toBase64(vars.summaryBytes) } } ]

logger.doc:name: AUDIT archived
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'ARCHIVED runId=' ++ vars.runId ++ ' file=' ++ vars.ctx.fileName ++ ' sha256=' ++ vars.ctx.fileChecksum]

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { path: '/chain/head', query: { reportType: vars.ctx.reportType, entityCode: vars.ctx.entityCode } }]
set-variable.doc:name: call chain head

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import chainHash from dwl::report output application/java --- { prevChainHash: payload.chainHash, chainHash: chainHash(payload.chainHash, vars.ctx.fileChecksum) }

set-variable.doc:name: call history
set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { path: '/runs', query: { reportType: vars.ctx.reportType, entityCode: vars.ctx.entityCode, status: 'SUCCESS', limit: (p('deviation.window') as Number) * 3 } }]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import deviationPct from dwl::report output application/java var window = p('deviation.window') as Number var history = ((payload default []) filter (not ($.isRevision default false))) map (($.recordCount default 0) as Number) var recent = if (sizeOf(history) > window) history[0 to window - 1] else history var pct = deviationPct(vars.ctx.recordCount, recent) --- { historySize: sizeOf(recent), average: if (isEmpty(recent)) null else (sum(recent) / sizeOf(recent)) as String {format: "0.00", locale: "en_US"} as Number, pct: pct, flagged: (pct != null) and (sizeOf(recent) >= (p('deviation.minHistory') as Number)) and (abs(pct) > (p('deviation.thresholdPercent') as Number)) }

logger.doc:name: AI unavailable
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'AI briefing skipped for ' ++ vars.runId ++ ': ' ++ (error.description default '')]

set-variable.doc:name: call patch
set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { method: 'PATCH', path: '/runs/' ++ vars.runId, body: { recordCount: vars.ctx.recordCount, totalAmount: vars.ctx.totalAmount, customerCount: vars.ctx.customerCount, completenessOk: true, isNilReport: vars.ctx.isNil, outputFilePath: vars.paths.submission, archiveFilePath: vars.ctx.archivePath, fileChecksum: vars.ctx.fileChecksum, detailChecksum: vars.ctx.detailChecksum, prevChainHash: vars.chain.prevChainHash, chainHash: vars.chain.chainHash, volumeDeviationPct: vars.deviation.pct, aiSummary: vars.aiSummary } }]
#[output application/java --- { method: 'PATCH', path: '/runs/' ++ vars.runId, body: { notificationStatus: 'FAILED', deliveryMethod: vars.delivery.method } }]
set-variable.doc:name: call patch

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { method: 'PATCH', path: '/runs/' ++ vars.runId, body: { notificationStatus: 'SENT', deliveryMethod: vars.delivery.method } }]
set-variable.doc:name: call patch

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { severity: 'WARNING', alertType: 'VOLUME_DEVIATION', title: 'Reported volume differs from the trailing average by ' ++ (vars.deviation.pct as String) ++ '%', runId: vars.runId, reportType: vars.ctx.reportType, entityCode: vars.ctx.entityCode, periodStart: vars.ctx.periodStart, periodEnd: vars.ctx.periodEnd, details: 'Records this period: ' ++ (vars.ctx.recordCount as String) ++ '. Trailing average of the last ' ++ (vars.deviation.historySize as String) ++ ' reports: ' ++ (vars.deviation.average as String) ++ '. Confirm this reflects genuine activity and not an upstream extraction problem.' ++ (if (isEmpty(vars.aiSummary default '')) '' else ('\n\nAI briefing (advisory): ' ++ vars.aiSummary)) }]
